title.en: San Diego: northbound SR-163 closure scheduled for November 1
title.es: San Diego: cierre de SR-163 al norte previsto para el 1 de noviembre

readerValue.en: For onward travel in San Diego: the scheduled road segment, hours and Caltrans-reported alternative. This report does not describe a border-port closure or estimate crossing delays.
readerValue.es: Para continuar tu viaje por San Diego: el tramo y horario previstos, y la alternativa indicada por Caltrans. Esta nota no describe un cierre de cruces fronterizos ni estima demoras para cruzar.

sources.title: Caltrans District 11 — Northbound SR-163 closure news listing
Northbound SR-163 Closed November 1 for More Than Pink Walk

text.en: Caltrans lists a scheduled closure of northbound SR-163 between A Street and Robinson in San Diego on Sunday, November 1, from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. Those are the hours printed in its announcement; the notice does not state a time zone.
text.es: Caltrans anuncia un cierre programado de SR-163 en sentido norte, entre A Street y Robinson en San Diego, para el domingo 1 de noviembre, de 5 a.m. a 11 p.m. Es el horario que aparece en el anuncio; el aviso no especifica una zona horaria.

evidence.excerpt: Northbound State Route 163 (SR-163) from A Street to Robinson on Sunday, November 1, from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.

text.en: The detailed Caltrans notice identifies I-5 as the alternative for northbound travel and says southbound SR-163 will remain open. Its announcement concerns a road segment within San Diego, rather than reporting that a border crossing is closed.
text.es: El aviso detallado de Caltrans indica I-5 como alternativa para circular hacia el norte y señala que SR-163 permanecerá abierta en sentido sur. El anuncio se refiere a un tramo vial dentro de San Diego, no a un cierre de un cruce fronterizo.

evidence.excerpt: Motorists will use Interstate 5 (I-5) to travel northbound. Southbound SR-163 will remain open.

text.en: Caltrans also states that the schedule is subject to change. The announced closure and its published hours are therefore conditional, not a guarantee that the plan will remain unchanged. This article reports the notice; it does not confirm conditions on the road.
text.es: Caltrans también advierte que el programa está sujeto a cambios. Por ello, el cierre anunciado y su horario publicado son condicionales, no una garantía de que el plan se mantenga sin modificaciones. Esta nota informa sobre el aviso; no confirma las condiciones en la carretera.

review.rationale: Distinct AI reviewer independently read both complete Caltrans pages. Both publish the November 1 northbound SR-163 schedule as 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.; no time zone was inferred or hours silently corrected. The detailed notice directly supports the I-5 alternative, southbound opening and conditional schedule. EN/ES scope, numbers and named locations agree. This is an attributed planned road operation, not port-entry, safety or live-wait advice. Publication dates are within 72 hours. Reviewed the 38-post inventory for semantic overlap: the prior road-tools guide does not report this event. Excerpts plus date evidence remain below 25 words per source. No human review claimed.
